info.name: Car Rental System API
info.description:
Manual + automated checks for the Car Rental System REST API.

1. Start the server (server.bat or ApiServerApplication in IntelliJ).
2. Run the folders in order, or use Run collection.

Ids are captured from responses into collection variables, and dates are computed from today, so the collection can be re-run without restarting the server.

Author: Jyoti Prakash Parida

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description: Run first: checks the server and prepares dates. Requires the server started with seed data (default).

exec: // Dates relative to today, so the collection works on any day and can be re-run.
const day = offset => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset); return d.getFullYear() + "-" + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(d.getDate()); };
pm.collectionVariables.set("lateReturn", day(4) + "T11:00:00");  // 2 days after the end date (today+2)
const byModel = m => res.data.find(v => v.model === m).id;
